outputs.explanation: Panel A (i-ii) shows a representative time-lapse of phase contrast images from mock-treated and saccharin-treated cells with no quantification or statistics; no replicate reporting is required.

Panel B shows representative phase contrast and fluorescence images (NAO staining, eCFP-FtsZ) with no quantification or statistical analysis; replicate reporting is not required for purely representative imaging.

replicate_statements: The images shown are representative examples from a minimum of three biological replicates.
outputs.explanation: Panel C shows representative time-lapse images without quantification, so formal replicate reporting is not strictly required; however, the caption explicitly states the images are representative of a minimum of three biological replicates, satisfying replication reporting.
